visual_review: Front E: right-hand grip, clean annulus, text legible.
Rear: right-hand grip, display and controls visible.
EF and exploded: both cartridges distinct; E/EF alternatives are not installed together.
Chassis and datum schematic: optical arrangement visible.
limitations: No FEA, drop, thermal, EMI, sealing, optical raytrace, lens intrusion, bayonet fit or tolerance-stack validation.
No mounting fit is claimed by STEP/STL files.
Battery, screen, sensor package and electronics are envelopes until vendors and PCB designs are frozen.
PCB component and connector keepouts are provisional; carrier fasteners and chassis assembly joints are not detailed.
